verses.text: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
lines: Doesn’t wisdom cry out?
Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

verses.text: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
lines: On the top of high places by the way,
where the paths meet, she stands.

verses.text: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
lines: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city,
at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

verses.text: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
lines: “I call to you men!
I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

verses.text: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
lines: You simple, understand prudence!
You fools, be of an understanding heart!

verses.text: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
lines: Hear, for I will speak excellent things.
The opening of my lips is for right things.

verses.text: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
lines: For my mouth speaks truth.
Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.text: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
lines: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness.
There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

verses.text: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
lines: They are all plain to him who understands,
right to those who find knowledge.

verses.text: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
lines: Receive my instruction rather than silver,
knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.text: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
lines: For wisdom is better than rubies.
All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

verses.text: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
lines: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling.
Find out knowledge and discretion.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
lines: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil.
I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

verses.text: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
lines: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine.
I have understanding and power.

verses.text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
lines: By me kings reign,
and princes decree justice.

verses.text: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
lines: By me princes rule,
nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

verses.text: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
lines: I love those who love me.
Those who seek me diligently will find me.

verses.text: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
lines: With me are riches, honor,
enduring wealth, and prosperity.

verses.text: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
lines: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold,
my yield than choice silver.

verses.text: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
lines: I walk in the way of righteousness,
in the middle of the paths of justice,

verses.text: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
lines: that I may give wealth to those who love me.
I fill their treasuries.

verses.text: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
lines: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work,
before his deeds of old.

verses.text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
lines: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning,
before the earth existed.

verses.text: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
lines: When there were no depths, I was born,
when there were no springs abounding with water.

verses.text: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
lines: Before the mountains were settled in place,
before the hills, I was born;

verses.text: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
lines: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields,
nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

verses.text: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
lines: When he established the heavens, I was there.
When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

verses.text: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
lines: when he established the clouds above,
when the springs of the deep became strong,

verses.text: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
lines: when he gave to the sea its boundary,
that the waters should not violate his commandment,
when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

verses.text: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
lines: then I was the craftsman by his side.
I was a delight day by day,
always rejoicing before him,

verses.text: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
lines: rejoicing in his whole world.
My delight was with the sons of men.

verses.text: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
lines: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me,
for blessed are those who keep my ways.

verses.text: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
lines: Hear instruction, and be wise.
Don’t refuse it.

verses.text: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
lines: Blessed is the man who hears me,
watching daily at my gates,
waiting at my door posts.

verses.text: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
lines: For whoever finds me, finds life,
and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

verses.text: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
lines: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul.
All those who hate me love death.”
